subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

FASTEN
solution: The correct answer is '**Affix**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Fasten**' is '**Affix**'. • **Fasten**: to close or join the two parts of something; to become closed or joined. (किसी वस्‍तु के दो भागों को बाँधना या बंद करना; बँध जाना या बंद हो जाना) • *Example: Please **fasten** your seat belts.* • **Affix**: to stick or join something to something else. (चिपकाना, जोड़ना) • *Example: The label should be firmly **affixed** to the package.* **Correct Answer:__** *Affix.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Detach**: to separate something from something it is connected to. (किसी वस्‍तु को उससे अलग करना जिससे वह जुड़ी है, वियोजित करना) • **Release**: to allow somebody/something to be free. [व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को (किसी से या कहीं से) मुक्त करना, जाने देना] • **Loosen**: to become or make something less tight. (ढीला हो जाना या कर देना) b9:Td73, The correct answer is **'What is disturbing you?'.**
